items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed area. Allow €320 gross for a localized patch and repaint, not a full-room repaint.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge on this contractor’s invoice. Allow €40 gross, consistent with the comparable single-trip charges.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers consumable sealing material used in the pipe repair. Allow €8 gross for a small quantity.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover replacement material for the failed indoor supply pipe. Allow €24 gross for one metre, subject to the pre-loss specification under 7.1.9.

items.description: Rock wool pipe insulation, one metre
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating insulation on the repaired section if it was present before the loss. Allow €13 gross for one metre.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installer labour at customary rates. Allow one hour at €96 gross for the localized pipe repair.

Section 7.1.8(b) excludes a separate charge for the contractor’s own diagnostic equipment, even when the investigation is covered. If this was instead a documented external hire necessary to locate the leak, allow €18 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers reasonable time for leak investigation, access and drying setup or checks, without duplicating the installer’s work. Allow about five hours at €95 gross rather than all nine billed hours for the localized loss.
Section 7.1.7(f) excludes the second travel charge on this invoice regardless of the number of visits. An eligible standalone trip would be about €40 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) allow one flat-rate deployment charge for necessary drying. Allow €145 gross for a short drying operation confined to the affected wall.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes the contractor’s blades as business equipment. The gross price benchmark for one blade is €10.

Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings actually installed in the repaired supply line; section 7.1.8(d) excludes unattributed materials. Allow €40 gross for two ordinary fittings at €20 each if attributable to the repair.

Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude duplicate or unsupported material charges, and the description does not establish a second metre. If separately documented as installed and necessary, allow €24 gross.
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude a second insulation charge for the same repaired section. If records establish a distinct necessary metre of pre-loss insulation, allow €13 gross.

Section 7.1.8(c) excludes duplicate labour, and the identical nine-hour entry does not identify a separate task. If distinct return-visit work is documented, allow about two hours at €95 gross under section 7.1.7(g).
